name: ZhWordConfusion
description: Common confusable words: 在/再, 做/作, 以/已, 象/像, 须/需, 登录/登陆, etc.

pairs.message: Confusion of 在/再: for goodbye, use “再见”.
Confusion of 在/再: for goodbye, use “再见吧”.
Confusion of 在/再: for goodbye, use “再见一次”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再次”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再说”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再考虑一下”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再看一遍”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再试一次”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再想想”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再等一下”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再来一次”.
Confusion of 在/再: use “再接再厉”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作业”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “做饭”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “做事”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “做梦”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “做工”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作家”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作品”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作用”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作者”.

Confusion of 做/作: use “作风”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作弊”.
Confusion of 做/作: use “作案”.
Confusion of 做/作: in the sense of “as / acting as”, use “作为”.
Confusion of 做/作: for the sense of completing something, prefer 做 → “做完作业”.
Confusion of 做/作: for the sense of completing something, prefer 做 → “做好准备”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “已经”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “已经完成”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “已经是”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “已经有”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “已经在”.
Confusion of 以/已: for later time, use “以后”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “以及”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “以免”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “以便”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “以防”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “以至于”.
Confusion of 以/已: use “以致”.
Confusion of 象/像: use “好像”.
In technical contexts, usually “成像”.
Use “录像”.
Use “照像”.
Use “像素”.
Use “肖像”.
Use “抽象”.
Prefer “形象”.
Use “像样”.
Use “像话”.
Redundant 须/需: prefer “必须要” or 需要.
Confusion of 须/需: use “必须”.
Confusion of 须/需: here prefer “需要”.
Confusion of 须/需: use “必须要求”.
Confusion of 须/需: as a noun, use “必需品”.
Prefer “不需”.
Confusion of 须/需: use “不需要”.
Confusion of 即/既: use “既然”.
Confusion of 即/既: use “即使”.
Prefer “既是”.
Fixed expression: use “既往”.
For signing in online, use 登录 (not 登陆): “登录网站”.
For signing in online, use 登录 (not 登陆): “登录系统”.

For signing in online, use 登录 (not 登陆): “用户登录”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “账号”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “账号密码”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “账户”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “账单”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “账本”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “记账”.
In modern Chinese, prefer “结账”.
Confusion of 其它/其他: modern usage prefers “其他的”.
Confusion of 其它/其他: modern usage prefers “其他人”.
Use “招聘启事” (public notice), not 启示.
Use “寻人启事” (public notice), not 启示.
Use “遗失启事” (public notice), not 启示.
Use “征稿启事” (public notice), not 启示.

Confusion of 反应/反映: for reporting/reflecting, use “反映问题”.
Confusion of 反应/反映: for reporting/reflecting, use “反映意见”.
Confusion of 截止/截至: for “as of / up to”, use “截至目前”.
Confusion of 截止/截至: for “as of / up to”, use “截至昨天”.
Confusion of 截止/截至: for “as of / up to”, use “截至上月”.
Confusion of 以至/以致: for a resulting consequence, use “以致”.
Confusion of 权力/权利: use “权力机关”.
Confusion of 权力/权利: use “保护权利”.
Confusion of 权力/权利: use “人身权利”.
Confusion of 权力/权利: use “通信权利”.
Prefer “制定计划”.
